blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A lone bettor bagged the ₱115.99 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office’s (PCSO) draw on Friday, Oct. 16, 2026. The winning ticket matched all six numbers — 08-22-19-10-35-27 — to claim the multimillion-peso prize. Meanwhile, no bettor won the ₱401.34 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot.
